title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons up to version 10.0.5. This vulnerability results from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in the context of affected web pages.
